sources.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection
sources.field_scope: Saved lead. Recreational, commercial, vessel, and guide credentials. The page states content last updated May 2026. Party and charter vessel registration is required to carry sport anglers for a fee. Guide registration is a separate person credential, and operators of a registered charter, party, or head boat are described as exempt while guiding on that vessel. No holder list. Office phones and emails were not copied.
sources.request_process: The page points purchases to the online licensing system and paper vessel applications to the marine fisheries office. The portal was not opened.

sources.field_scope: Current compilation of section 26-142a. Defines a party or charter fishing vessel. Requires a registration issued to the owner. Fee $315. The operator must hold a current Coast Guard passenger-for-hire license. Section history records the party-or-charter amendments as effective January 1, 2016.
sources.request_process: Application containing the information the commissioner prescribes, plus the fee.

sources.field_scope: Guide-services registration. Fee $100. Expires the last day of December. Collects name, residential address, business address, business telephone, and services offered. Exempts the user, operator, or crew of a 26-142a charter, party, or head boat from subsection (a). Subsection (c) limits some vessel guide services to two customers. That sentence was not applied to a registered party boat. Effective January 1, 2015.

Fishing-license requirement and the passenger exemption. No fishing license is required for a passenger on a party or charter fishing vessel registered under section 26-142a and operating solely in the marine district.

Marine waters fishing license. The same passenger exemption for a registered party or charter fishing vessel operating solely in the marine district. History of the current wording is effective January 1, 2016.

Reporting. A party or charter registration holder must report what the commissioner requires, which may include passengers carried to fish, area, effort, and catch. The section does not publish the reports or say they may be copied into a directory.
sources.bulk: Reports to the commissioner. No public file was found.
sources.request_process: Forms and intervals set by the commissioner. No public download.

sources.field_scope: Boating chapter search extract. A person who holds a current Coast Guard passenger-for-hire license and a current party or charter fishing vessel registration under section 26-142a is not prohibited from operating a marine-dealer-numbered vessel for a recreational charter fishing guide service. Not a roster. The section body was not downloaded as its own file.
sources.note: Search extract of the current chapter text.

sources.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection
sources.field_scope: Vessel permit application, revision April 2024. Search extract. The PDF was not downloaded. Party and charter registration is $315 and is required for each vessel. The form asks for vessel name, state registration or Coast Guard number, length, capacity, home port, Connecticut landing port, and marina. Personal fields were not stored.
sources.request_process: Mail to the license and revenue unit. The mailing address on the form was not copied into the notes as a contact channel beyond the statute's application requirement.

sources.field_scope: Site disclaimer. No warranty for documents or data. Data are not legal documents. The disclaimer applies to individual and aggregate use. Permission is required to reproduce the state arms, seal, and CT.gov logo. No copyright grant for a license table.
sources.bulk: Silent on bulk reuse of registration files.
sources.request_process: Seal and logo requests go to the offices named on the page. Those addresses were not used as a fishing-roster request path.

Passenger counts and telephones are uneven, and the two copies of one card do not use the same telephone. Telephones were not copied. Not a department registration extract.
